newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April 1-15 palm oil exports 336,791t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April 1-15 palm oil exports 336,791t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Tuesday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for April 1-15 at 336,791 tonnes against 311,924 tonnes in March 1-15.
It said the exports comprised 109,474 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 113,892 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 33,750 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 79,675 tonnes.
Pakistan was the top buyer during the period, taking 71,050 tonnes, followed by India which bought 43,933 tonnes, China (34,376 tonnes), Turkey (19,350 tonnes) and South Korea (15,650 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 59,219 tonnes.
